Only for validation fixtures (R16-4-7 / ladder L2-L3); production runs keep the authoritative face_case5_config_c.json.

The capacity tiers are sized against the astra_compute_20.csv 10 s / 150 s windows using 524288 B/token whole-instance KV (2(K+V) x hidden 4096 x 2 B x 32 layers; 143636-token max session ~11.7 GiB/rank at TP=6, ~16 GiB/rank 9-instance aggregate at 10 s, ~86 GiB/rank at 150 s). Aggregate ratios are under-subscribed on the passing tiers: pressure comes from sticky-home skew and copy working-copy double residency, not aggregate shortage.
